attempted_claim: Let D_3 = {lambda(f)^{-chi(S)} : f:S->S fully-punctured pseudo-Anosov with b_1(M_f) >= 3}, where M_f is the mapping torus. Determine m_3 = min D_3 as an exact finite value and classify up to flow equivalence/conjugacy the fully-punctured maps attaining it; i.e. prove the sharp universal gap lambda(f)^{-chi(S)} >= m_3 for this class with equality characterization.
decisive_failure: No sharp uniform gap, discreteness/attainment certificate, exact optimizer, or equality classification was established; candidate crowding table is illustrative only and carries no realizability certificate; fibered-cone infinitude argument blocks finite-census routes but proves no new theorem.
